License notices
---------------

3Dmol-LICENSE.txt reproduces the package's complete LICENSE file, including
the BSD-3-Clause terms for 3Dmol.js and its GLmol, Three.js and jQuery notices.
3Dmol-min.js.LICENSE.txt reproduces the accompanying Webpack-extracted notice
referenced by the JavaScript file's first line. These notices are distributed
with the viewer in both source checkouts and Python wheels.

The trFlow project's own license does not replace these third-party notices.
The bundled viewer is served locally; browsers do not fetch it from a CDN.
